name: placement-picker
about: New Space's Run on menu: This Mac, then your machines that provide Spaces (a Mac mini on the relay with two of four Spaces and its two macOS VMs in use, a Linux box added by its Tailscale address, an offline studio), then, with the Your cloud experiment, your connected cloud. Disabled entries say why (offline, at its limit, not a Mac); choosing one sets the create's on (local, host:<machine>, aws). Turning Your cloud off while AWS is chosen goes back to this Mac and leaves AWS connected; a machine that leaves the list does the same.

limits.reason: Apple's macOS license allows two macOS VMs per Mac

offers.reason: macOS on AWS needs EC2 Mac (24 h minimum); not offered.
